title: Allowing two accessory homes per residential lot
summary: On June 19, Bill 78 was before the council; it would allow two accessory dwelling units, or extra small homes, on residential lots. On June 3, the committee approved a revised version after all three planning commissions recommended approval with 13 changes. State law requires counties to adopt such rules by December 31, 2026.
